test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five men namely Bob, Bran, Bot, Batista and Brian are sitting in a circle facing the centre. Brian is sitting to the immediate left of Bot and the immediate right of Bob. Batista sits second to the left of Brian. Who sits to the immediate right of Bran?
solution:
Given: Five men namely Bob, Bran, Bot, Batista and Brian are sitting in a circle facing the centre.

1) Brian is sitting to the immediate left of Bot and the immediate right of Bob.

2) Batista sits second to the left of Brian.

And, 'Bran' will sits on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a68ac96aca8cf3f48292960f4c699a72e0f159f73a718c6c867c8846cbed28e7.png] 

So, 'Batista' sits to the immediate right of Bran.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
